plan: A nightmare jungler who cuts the enemy team's vision and swoops onto his target.
aSurveiller: His R (Paranoia). He reduces your vision then flies to a champion: when the screen darkens, group up.
contrer: When the screen darkens, group up: he is about to land on an isolated target.
Move away from him to break his fear tether (E) before it ends.
His W blocks a spell: don't use your big spell first.
forces: His R engages from very far.
Blocks a spell with his W.
faiblesses: Weak if the target is surrounded.

sorts.P: Every few seconds, an area attack that heals him.
sorts.Q: Blade that leaves a trail and speeds him up.
sorts.W: Blocks a spell and gains attack speed.
sorts.E: Tether that fears if you stay close.
sorts.R: Reduces enemy vision and flies to a champion.

momentFort: Farms fast and rarely ganks early. His real spike is level 6: when the screen darkens, he can land on any lane.
